meta.title: CV - Ruben Alvarez
meta.description: Résumé of Ruben Alvarez, Head of Software Development based in Madrid. Product delivery with AI-assisted Spec Driven Development: OpenSpec, TypeScript, Flutter, DDD and the Smartsheet ecosystem.

name: Ruben Alvarez
title: Head of Software Development · AI-assisted delivery
profile: I lead **product development at Uniendo Nodos** with AI-assisted **Spec Driven Development (SDD)**: the AI implements and people steer the cycle — specify, design, review, validate and ship. This is not a hunch: we **measure it against our own repositories** and we budget from those numbers. And that method ships **real product to production and to the app stores**, not prototypes. I bring almost twenty years split between **hands-on development**, the **technical leadership** of two companies I co-founded and **agile coaching**. The bottleneck is no longer typing code but **deciding well, slicing work into shippable pieces and verifying what gets delivered**. I work with **solid practices** — TDD, DDD, continuous delivery — and I enjoy looking for **better ways to do things**; today that means steering the definition of the **harness** (rules, agents and automations) that lets the team move faster without losing control.

projects.title: OwnAutoCare
projects.shortDescription: **My own product**, from the app to the website. Vehicle maintenance history for **iPhone, iPad, Mac and Android**, published on the **App Store** and **Google Play**. Built with **Flutter** and with **no backend at all**: data lives in the user's own Google Drive, iCloud or OneDrive, with no extra accounts and no intermediate database — privacy is an architectural decision, not a promise. Service log, attached invoices, cost tracking and full history export. Built end to end with **Spec Driven Development**, using **OpenSpec**. The product website —**Astro**, bilingual, a blog with scheduled publishing and continuous delivery— is mine too.

projects.title: This very résumé
projects.shortDescription: The page you are reading. **Astro** and **Tailwind**, bilingual with an automated check that both dictionaries stay in sync, light and dark themes with browser detection, and a print stylesheet so it downloads as a PDF. End-to-end tests on **Chromium and WebKit** plus visual regression snapshots, and a **Lighthouse audit that fails the build if any category drops below 100**. Continuous delivery to **Netlify** straight from the workflow.

projects.title: Movi-info
projects.shortDescription: Movie information management, used as an architecture testbed. **React 19** with **TypeScript** and **Vite** on the frontend and **.NET 10** on the backend, both with **hexagonal architecture** and the **DDD, Repository, Criteria** patterns plus a **query bus (CQRS)** on MediatR. Tests at four levels: unit, infrastructure against the live API, acceptance with **Gherkin** and accessibility with **jest-axe**. Continuous delivery via **GitHub Actions** to **Netlify** and **Render**, served from a single origin through a reverse proxy.

experience.title: Head of Software Development
responsibilities: I lead the company's product development — **architect and lead developer**, with a team — mainly within the **Smartsheet** ecosystem, where Uniendo Nodos is a **partner**.
We work with **Spec Driven Development**: every change is specified, designed and reviewed before a line is written. **The AI implements; we decide, review and answer for the result.**
**162 changes specified, tested and deployed in a single quarter, with 18% corrective work**, by a small team. I budget from those same measured figures instead of guessing.

**Klonup**, a backup SaaS for Smartsheet in commercial operation: I designed its **multi-phase execution engine**, with call limits against the API and **partial and full rollback** on failure, and the **continuous delivery** that ships it with tests as a gate.
Architect and lead developer of a **multi-tenant SaaS platform**: per-organisation isolation in the database itself, passwordless access, multi-currency plans and a full free-trial lifecycle.

Steered the definition of the **engineering harness** the organisation works with —architecture rules, *skills* and agents versioned alongside the code— and designed a **control plane** that runs agents in ephemeral environments **with zero long-lived credentials**. Backed by **mandatory TDD** and over **6,500 automated tests**.
